name: Check the submitted fork: its exact accepted tree passes and every pending commit stays visible
Commit later edits to the guard and proof: neither file is exempt from drift detection
Try to approve an unproven commit through dirty or staged proof: both attempts remain red
Recover an archived cut into a disposable repository: the documented fetch and cherry-pick restore its original tree
Run the nightly command green, red, and red again: logs persist and only one same-day inbox note and wake are created
Run nightly when its upstream remote is missing: exit 2 is logged and delivered as a red inbox note
Accept a merge carrying an unlisted commit: it fails until that commit is explicitly pending with its named bead
